jobs.description:
JMP, a subsidiary of SAS, is committed to empowering scientists and engineers via our world-class family of statistical software products. For over 35 years, JMP has enabled customers to speed new drugs to market, to design better products and processes, and to figure out how to restore ecosystems. Advancements are made when brilliant people use JMP statistical discovery software to see what they’ve not seen before. If you are a problem solver, a connector, and someone who enjoys helping others, then you might just be the next person to join this dynamic, growing, and global team.

About the job

We are looking to hire an experienced New Business Salesperson to join our successful sales team, selling JMP software to both new and existing customers. To join this team the successful candidate will need to prove their record of consistently over-achieving sales targets while helping their customers to deliver long-term value from the use of their products.

You will be responsible for finding new business and managing existing accounts where you will have ownership of the full sales cycle through to close. You will be responsible for sales of JMP software products in a high volume, multi-tasking sales environment.

You will work with the JMP Sales Team to demonstrate and prove JMP’s customer value and drive new business across Ireland and Nordics.

As an Account Executive, you will:

• Create opportunities and customer alignment to JMP’s likely customer profile.

• Prospect within the assigned sales territory to uncover business needs.

• Help define and deliver the territory and account management plan; identify new target accounts with high "close" potential, qualify sales opportunities and accurately forecast your pipeline of qualified sales opportunities to deliver JMP software sales revenue.

• Work closely with the sales territory teams, including Inside Sales, Sales Engineer and JMP management in all aspects of the sales process.

• Prepare quotations and proposal information as needed; work with relevant JMP departments to create and finalize contracts.

• Engage with senior Decision-Makers in your existing customers to ensure ongoing satisfaction with their JMP products and to discover and develop additional revenue opportunities.

• Apply your knowledge of JMP’s marketing goals, JMP applications, supported hardware platforms, marketing and business trends, and industry knowledge to assess your customer’s potential needs.

• Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals.

• Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

Required qualifications

• Requires a minimum of 5 years of experience in a full sales cycle - with a successful and proven track-record - in the sales of computer software solutions or scientific and engineering hardware (including products and services related to JMP’s target markets). Specific experience related to JMP’s target markets may be considered in combination with the above requirements.

• Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business, Marketing, MIS, or other relevant discipline.

• This is primarily a new business role which would suit a focused and high activity salesperson. The new business revenue comes from new-name accounts and growing the use of JMP software for existing customers, where the sales opportunities need to be uncovered and developed.

• Ability to analyse and evaluate territory dynamics and develop a sales plan; ability to communicate technical and business concepts and relate them to JMP software and user needs; ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Knowledge of sales techniques; knowledge of software acquisitions cycles and buying influences.

• Ability to travel regularly and extensively within the territory and occasionally internationally.

• Hybrid work style.

• Proof of Right to work in the UK or Denmark with ability to travel across Europe. Fluency in Danish is preferred.

• Equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications.

Additional competencies, knowledge and skills

• Creating Demand Through Insight - Identifying the targeted account’s business challenges and needs and their probable causes; providing and provoking convincing insights that compel decision makers to discover or reconsider unrecognized problems and opportunities and the value of addressing them with new solutions to achieve better long-term results (e.g., profitability, revenue, market share).

• Advancing Sales Discussions - Leading discussions with influential decision makers that progress the sale by effectively clarifying information, offering insights, addressing objections, and gaining agreement to move to the next step in the buying process.

• Driving for Results - Setting high goals for personal and group accomplishment; using measurement methods to monitor progress toward goals; tenaciously working to meet or exceed goals while deriving satisfaction from that achievement and continuous improvement.

You are welcome here.

At SAS and JMP, it’s not about fitting into our culture - it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

Additional Information:

SAS and JMP only send emails from verified "sas.com" and “jmp.com” email addresses and never ask for sensitive, personal information or money. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, for, or on behalf of SAS or JMP, please contact us at Recruitingsupport@sas.com before taking any further action.

#JMP

What if your curiosity could help build the world we all imagine?

Are you eager to impact modern society while growing your professional and personal skills in a welcoming environment? Launch your career with our Forensic & Integrity Services team at EY, starting August 2027. We’re committed to investing in your potential throughout your journey.

The opportunity: your next adventure awaits

As a Graduate in Forensic & Integrity Services, you’ll join our Assurance services, gaining experience alongside forensic professionals across different sectors. Our team spans accounting, law, finance, data analytics, technology and investigations, helping clients navigate sensitive challenges.

From the start, you’ll join project teams investigating complex matters across industries. Assignments may involve financial and accounting records, electronic data, interviews, policies, contracts, and transaction documentation.

Depending On The Assignments, You May Work On

• Supporting investigations into suspected fraud, misconduct, conflicts of interest and other integrity concerns

• Reviewing financial records, transactions, contracts and documentation to identify patterns and relevant facts

• Assisting with whistleblower investigations and other sensitive fact-finding assignments

• Analyzing structured and unstructured data, including financial data and electronic communications

• Supporting compliance reviews and assessments of ethics, governance and internal control frameworks

• Contributing to interviews, evidence summaries, presentations and investigation reports

We offer varied work experience that helps you grow professionally in an inclusive culture. You’ll be surrounded by committed colleagues, we value spending time together, both at work and socially.

Through internal coaching and training, you’ll build the skills to stay relevant now and, in the future, while growing a network of colleagues, mentors and leaders at EY.

To learn more about our teams within Assurance, please visit our career page.

What We Look For

• 
Enjoys understanding how facts and financial information connect

• 
Approaches complex information in a structured and analytical way

• 
Pays attention to detail without losing sight of the broader issue

• 
Can communicate clearly and objectively, both in writing and in conversation

• 
Takes responsibility, asks questions and is motivated to learn

• 
Qualifications:

• 
You completed your studies in 2026 or are set to graduate in summer 2027 with a degree within economics, finance, law, data analytics and/or technology (e.g. cand.merc.(aud.), cand.merc.(jur.), cand.jur., cand.polit, data science or similar).

• 
You communicate fluently in both Danish and English, verbally and in writing.

What’s In It For You

• An exciting introductory program with new graduates across the Nordic region.

• Supportive onboarding with your own buddy and counselor.

• Flexible and hybrid working conditions.

• Highly collaborative teams and great support of a network of knowledgeable colleagues.

• Continuous development and opportunities to grow your career.

What You Can Expect

If this position interests you and you recognize yourself in the description, we would like to hear from you soon. Application deadline: 15 November 2026.

Recruitment Process

• Application: Fill out the application form and upload your CV, cover letter and a copy of your most recent grade transcript.

• Assessment: After submitting your application, you will receive a link to our assessment within a few days. It takes about 20 minutes and must be completed by 18 November.

• Video: Following the assessment, complete a brief video interview of three questions on your motivation, submitted by 22 November.

• Interview: Selected candidates will be invited to face-to-face interviews on an ongoing basis at the EY Office in Copenhagen.

As we review applications continuously, we recommend applying promptly, as the position may be filled before the deadline.

Please note that only applicants who complete the assessment and video will be considered. We look forward to your application!

Get to know us. Follow us on Instagram at ey_denmark

jobs.occupation: Compliance Product Enablement Student Assistant - Danish Speaking
jobs.description:
**In this Compliance Product Enablement Student Assistant role, you’ll be…

**

• Translating legal documents and compliance-related content from English into Danish, ensuring legal precision, clarity, and consistency.

• Translating marketing materials containing compliance concepts to fit regional standards without losing accuracy.

• Supporting our software compliance work by helping maintain alignment with local laws, regulations, and industry standards.

• Assisting in the creation and maintenance of compliance blueprints alongside experienced market experts and our partners.

• Supported through a mentor-mentee relationship with a senior compliance specialist.

**Who is the Product Enablement Team?

**The Product Enablement Team sits at the intersection of our compliance domain expertise and market expansion. We ensure that our platform content, legal frameworks, and product materials are localised accurately across every market Formalize operates in.

We are part of Commercial, partnering closely with stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and Legal to bridge domain expertise with localised execution.

Essentially, we contribute to our vision by ensuring our software and messaging speak the language of local compliance with absolute precision.

**What you’ll bring:

**

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Communication, Business, or a related field.

• Native-level fluency in Danish with professional written and spoken English.

• Strong written communication skills with close attention to detail, tone, and legal nuance.

• A structured, proactive mindset with an interest in learning compliance frameworks and software localisation.

• Availability to work at least 15 hours per week at our Aarhus office.

**What do we offer you?

**

• An hourly salary ranging from 155 to 195 DKK.

• Our salary levels are directly linked to our structured career framework, which includes regular performance reviews, clear progression, and bi-annual growth talks.

• Dedicated guidance through a mentor–mentee relationship with a senior compliance expert.

• Thorough pre-boarding and onboarding to set you up for success.

• A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.

• An office-first culture in a central location in Aarhus C (Frederiksgade 25), with benefits including lunch, health insurance, and social events.

• A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects.

****Our recruitment process

• Send your application and upload relevant information

• 15-30 minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team

• Completion of Personality Assessment

• 45-minute in-person final interview with our Product Compliance Consultant Lead, Rasmus, and another student from the team.

****About Formalize

****Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid & Munich. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from 19 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learning from our mistakes, and growing together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy.

Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

****Ready to apply?

****We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

Make an impact with Laerdal!

Do you want to develop cutting-edge products that train healthcare professionals and ultimately help save lives? Join us at Laerdal Copenhagen, where we build world-class digital learning solutions used by millions globally.

The Team

We are building new capabilities for RQI (Resuscitation Quality Improvement) that help hospitals run CPR training the way their organisation actually works. That means connecting the training station to the learning systems hospitals already use, removing the friction between a learner walking up to the cart and starting a session, and giving the people who implement RQI the tools to configure it for their own context. You'll help shape these capabilities and weave them into one cohesive experience. In that way, your work will directly expand access to CPR training and support Laerdal's mission to help save more lives.

We work close to our customers: we visit hospitals, test our assumptions and build on modern technology, with an eye on where resuscitation training is heading next. You will work in a cross-functional product team in Laerdal Copenhagen with product management, design and engineering, as well as with other product teams across Copenhagen, Stavanger, and the US. The team owns the core platform capabilities and collaborates closely with partners across the wider RQI ecosystem.

The Role

We are looking for a React Frontend Engineer with experience building modern web and mobile applications. In this role, you will take ownership of the key user-facing flows of the platform.

You will,

• experiment, build and maintain web and mobile user interfaces using React and React Native

• collaborate closely with backend engineers on API design and data flows

• work closely with product managers and designers to translate user needs into intuitive frontend experiences

• contribute to the frontend architecture, patterns, and technical direction

• work in a "you build it, you run it" mindset with responsibility for production quality

Your Background

• Around 3+ years of professional software development experience

• Strong experience with React in production systems

• Hands-on experience with React Native and mobile development

• Understanding of frontend architecture, state management, and performance considerations

• Care deeply about usability, quality, and real user impact

• Enjoy close collaboration with designers and product managers

• Actively using AI-assisted development in your daily work

Our Tech Stack

• React (Web) & React Native (Mobile)

• C# / .NET Backend

• API‑driven integrations

• Cloud‑based infrastructure & modern CI/CD practices

Why Laerdal

Laerdal is a mission‑driven company working to help save one million more lives, every year, by 2030 (One Million Lives by Laerdal: A Shared Goal for 2030 - Laerdal - One Million Lives). You’ll be part of a collaborative, international environment with a strong focus on product quality, real‑world impact, and sustainable work–life balance.

We have a collaborative and diverse environment with lots of passion and energy. Our workplace is friendly and casual, located in an old warehouse close to Islands Brygge.

This is a full‑time role based at Laerdal's office in Copenhagen. We expect most workdays to be spent on‑site, with some flexibility for remote work during the week. You will report to the Engineering Manager and work closely with senior peers across engineering, product, and design.

Get a feeling of who we are in Laerdal Copenhagen in this video.

Reach Out

When you are ready to apply, please submit your CV and a short motivation letter. (remember that LinkedIn only allows one document, so just merge them into one):

• CV

• Motivation letter

If you have any questions that might keep you from applying, reach out to Lukas Zimmerli (Engineering Manager) at lukas.zimmerli@laerdal.com.

Ready to build and lead an aftermarket organization that sets the standard in our industry?

This is your chance to join Weibel and take the lead of our growing Aftermarket organization. You will join a Danish high-tech market leader with a predominantly export based customer base. We are a profitable growth company with a strong position in our core markets and ambitious plans for expansion into new and significant business areas.

As our installed base of radar systems grows worldwide, so does the importance of our aftermarket business. We offer a key leadership role with a real mandate to shape, build and develop the full aftermarket and customer support function, from people and processes to strategy and growth.

Lead aftermarket excellence for state-of-the-art radar systems

As Aftermarket Director you will have overall responsibility for how we support our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of their systems. You will lead the existing Aftermarket & Training team and build new capabilities within Integrated Logistics Support (ILS), Technical Publications, Contract Management and Lifecycle Engineering. You will work closely with Sales, Programs, Product Management, R&D and Production.

Your primary responsibilities will be

• Aftermarket & Training: Lead the Aftermarket & Training team, including field service, FAT/SAT support, technical support and customer training worldwide.

• Integrated Logistics Support (ILS): Build and manage an ILS team covering logistics support analysis, spare parts and repair planning, supportability and obsolescence management.

• Technical Publications: Establish and manage technical publications, ensuring that manuals, maintenance documentation and training material meet customer and industry requirements.

• Contract Management: Own aftermarket contract management, including service and support agreements, warranty, spare parts and repair contracts – from bid to delivery.

• Lifecycle Engineering: Lead lifecycle engineering, including upgrades, modifications, reliability and maintainability improvements throughout the system lifecycle.

• Strategy and growth: Develop and execute the aftermarket strategy with a focus on customer satisfaction, recurring revenue and profitable growth.

• People leadership: Recruit, develop and lead managers and specialists, and set clear goals, KPIs and processes across the aftermarket organization.

Your qualifications and background

We are looking for a strong people leader with a relevant technical or business background and a proven track record of building and driving aftermarket, customer support or service operations for complex technical products, ideally within defense, aerospace or another high-tech industry.

You combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic and results-oriented mindset. You are comfortable operating in an international environment and know how to engage effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from technical specialists to senior customer representatives.

We imagine that you:

• Have led aftermarket, service, support, maintenance or customer success organizations and excel at stakeholder management.

• Have a proven track record of building and scaling organizations, capabilities and operating models in a growing business environment.

• Possess a strong commercial mindset and understand how to develop service offerings, strengthen customer partnerships and drive recurring revenue.

• Have a solid understanding of lifecycle management, service contracts, supportability, logistics or integrated product support.

• Are equally comfortable setting strategic directions and driving operational execution.

• Collaborate effectively across functions and are skilled at aligning engineering, sales, production and program organizations around shared goals.

• Are familiar with AI and its business applications and actively leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making and business outcomes.

• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of aftermarket at Weibel. You will play a key role in strengthening customer partnerships, driving long-term growth and building an organization that supports our global ambitions.

Please note that it is a requirement that you can obtain a security clearance, since some of your tasks will involve classified information and take place in restricted areas.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the” Apply” button.

The deadline for your application is 23. October 2026.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.

We are searching for a Vendor Financial Specialist. You will be responsible for managing and optimizing financial and cost-related matters for outsourcing contracts with third party vendors.

BEC is transforming into a leading fintech integrator for Danish banks by strengthening our product offering and transforming the technology estate. A central part of this journey is BEC’s tech transformation where outsourcing will continue to be a natural, continuous part of the operating model to reduce complexity, increase efficiency, ensure access to international specialists, and focus the company. BEC has partnered with outsourcing vendors to manage many existing services and future-proof important platforms efficiently.

To support the strategic aspirations BEC are changing its structure to handle a multi-vendor setup. To ensure vendors and partners live up to BEC’s requirements and expectations and that their work is based on BEC priorities, a new area is being established for managing and governing vendors and partners. The new setup will handle BEC’s main partners.

As Vendor Financial Specialist, you will have a role in setting up and driving monitoring, measuring, and reporting on the financial and cost performance of the outsourcing agreements. As a Vendor Financial Specialist, you will be responsible for maximizing the financial mechanisms agreed in the outsourcing contracts with third party vendors to ensure optimal performance. This includes the development and negotiation of new commercial mechanisms with the vendors to support the strategic aspirations.

If you are experienced with optimizing finance and cost related to outsourcing contracts, supporting business and operations while having a pragmatic and collaborative mindset, this role is for you.

**Primary tasks and responsibilities:

**

• Handle financial analysis and support business units with financial insights on the outsourcing agreements.

• Monitor and follow up on KPIs with financial impact.

• Oversee financial and cost reporting, providing accurate and timely reports supporting decision-making.

• Manage cost control for vendor contracts and highlighting opportunities for cost optimization.

• Leading and supporting commercial negotiations of financials for new strategic projects

**To succeed you will:

**

• Be proficient in financial reporting.

• Have experience with financial analysis – ideally in a vendor management or outsourcing environment.

• Have experience with providing supporting activities to commercial negotiations

• Demonstrate skills in cost control and budgeting, while looking for opportunities to improve setup and performance.

• Be methodical, structured, and detail-oriented, ensuring accuracy in data and reporting.

• Be excellent at cross-organizational collaboration.

• Thrive in a fast-paced and continuously evolving environment.

**Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

**We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

• Pension scheme

• Health and dentist insurance

• Referral bonus

**What does the recruitment process look like?

**

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

• Meet your future manager and team: See who you'll be working closely with.

• Personality and cognitive test: Let's learn more about you.

• Meet our talent partner and your future manager once more: Get feedback on your test results.

• Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Attraction Partner Anders Skak-Arnstrup at rud@bec.dk.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

jobs.occupation: Balance of Plant Technician - Thor Offshore Windfarm
jobs.description:
RWE Renewables Denmark A/S

To start as soon as possible, full time, permanent

Join RWE’s offshore operations team as a Balance of Plant (BoP) Technician and help ensure the safe and reliable operation of Thor Offshore Wind Farm, Denmark’s largest offshore wind farm. Working in small teams alongside external service providers, you will represent RWE offshore and contribute to the inspection, maintenance and structural integrity of critical balance-of-plant assets. Once fully operational in 2027, Thor will have a capacity of more than 1 GW and generate green electricity for more than one million Danish households.

About the role

• Perform visual and technical inspections of turbine foundations, transition pieces, boat landings, internal and external ladders, and secondary steel structures.

• Identify and report corrosion, weld fatigue, structural damage and other technical faults.

• Monitor structural integrity, including checks of cathodic corrosion protection systems.

• Oversee scour protection systems around offshore foundations and coordinate with remotely operated vehicle teams to assess seabed erosion.

• Inspect and maintain foundation davit cranes and support wind turbine generator activities when required.

• Document completed work in Fluix and create fault notifications in SAP.

• Contribute to risk assessments and method statements for repair and maintenance activities.

• Coordinate the work of external service providers and ensure compliance with occupational health and safety requirements.

Job requirements and experience

• Completed vocational training as a mechanical, electrical or wind turbine technician, or an equivalent technical qualification.

• At least two years of maintenance experience within offshore wind, maritime operations or utilities.

• Strong HSEQ awareness and knowledge of relevant legislation, standards and industry requirements.

• Experience in planning and coordinating service assignments.

• Good IT skills, including experience with tools such as Microsoft Office, Fluix or SAP.

• Good spoken and written English; Danish language skills are an advantage.

• Ability to work offshore and obtain a valid GWO certificate.

• A high level of physical fitness, with the ability to work in demanding conditions and adverse weather at sea, combined with a proactive, collaborative and solution-focused approach.

Apply with just a few clicks: ad code 93746, application period: 25/10/2026.

Any questions? Contact HR: Magnus Aarenstrup

We look forward to meeting you. Of course, you can find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Xing, too. #LI-MA1

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, disability, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, age, sexual orientation, and identity. #inclusionmatters

Thor will be located approximately 22 kilometres off the coast of Thorsminde on the west coast of Jutland. With a planned capacity of more than 1 GW and 72 Siemens Gamesa SG 14-236 DD offshore wind turbines, it is being developed as Denmark’s largest offshore wind farm to date. Once fully operational in 2027, Thor is expected to generate green electricity equivalent to the annual consumption of more than one million Danish households.

A property manager can handle 600 tenants. That's the industry limit. Why? Because the work scales linearly: matching bank transactions to invoices, chasing late payments, answering tenant questions, coordinating repairs, preparing legal notices, renewing leases. More tenants, more of the same manual work.

With AI, that limit disappears. And both landlords and tenants get a better experience.

**About Rumli

**Eight years in property operations. ~1,000 customers across Denmark, the Netherlands, and Germany. We know this industry: the workflows, the pain points, the regulations.

Now we're making a big move: becoming a property manager. Tenant communication, bookkeeping, coordinating repairs. We handle it all. A landlord shouldn't chase late payments or find a plumber at 10 pm. We do it for them.

We're building an entirely new platform to power this. AI-native from day one. Profitable, real customers, expanding across the Nordics.

**Why this is interesting

**Property management is a great domain for a product engineer. Thousands of similar transactions, pattern-based decisions, templated documents. And 1,000 customers who will tell you exactly where it hurts. Years of domain knowledge, ready to turn into a product.

We ship with AI agents built into the workflow. Our codebase has custom skills to improve our workflow. AI writes a lot of the code; we review it. That means the slow part of building isn't writing code anymore. It's knowing what to build. That's what this role is about.

**The role

**You are autonomous and independent, working with the team to solve property managers' pains and make them as efficient as possible.

• Talk to customers and property managers. Find out what actually slows them down

• Decide what to build, then build it. Mockup, prototype, ship, measure, repeat

• Own features end-to-end. Database to API to UI

• Build AI into core product features

• Work directly with our co-founder on product direction

We need someone who looks at a messy problem and figures out what to build, and doesn't wait for a spec.

**Tech stack

**TypeScript everywhere. But does it even matter anymore?

• Frontend: Next.js, React, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS

• Backend: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM

• Infra: AWS Lambda, CDK, RDS, EventBridge, SQS

**What We're Looking For

**

• Product thinking. You understand what it takes to build a profitable product. You are not here just to handle tickets.

• Strong product mindset. Agents can code, but they need scoping and steering.

• You've shipped things people actually use, and you can show them.

• Comfortable talking to customers.

• Experience with coding agents.

• Work independently.

• Copenhagen-based (on-site).

Big plus: AWS, AI experience (prompt engineering, RAG, agents), fintech/proptech background, a side project you're proud of.

**Compensation & Benefits

**

• Compensation: 50–65K DKK, depending on experience and demonstrated competencies

• Equity: Employee warrants offering real ownership in the company

• Workspace: Centrally located Copenhagen office

• Perks: Daily lunch included

**Why Rumli?

**Real customers. Brand-new codebase. Small team where your decisions matter.

We're rebuilding from the ground up with AI as the foundation. If you want to decide what property software should do, not just build what someone else specified, reach out.

We’re looking for a Legal Engineer to join our Product team in Copenhagen. Someone with a strong legal foundation who is excited about AI, technology, and finding better ways to do legal work. You’ll get hands-on with our product, work on real legal problems, and help us build AI-powered tools that lawyers can actually rely on.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**As a Legal Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of law, AI, and product. You'll join our Product team and work closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales.

This is a hands-on role: rather than practising law, you'll use your legal expertise to evaluate AI-generated legal work, figure out where and why it falls short, and turn real legal problems into scalable AI-powered workflows. It's a good fit if you like getting deep into legal detail but also enjoy stepping back to ask why something works and how it could work better.

**What You'll Do

**

• Evaluate and improve legal AI quality: test AI-generated legal research and analysis for correctness, completeness, reasoning, and source selection. Investigate where outputs fall short and turn findings into actionable input for Product and Engineering.

• Turn legal problems into AI-powered workflows: break down how lawyers actually perform a task, define what a good outcome looks like, and help develop, test, and refine workflows that solve it at scale.

• Bring UK legal expertise into product development: apply your knowledge of UK law, legal sources, and lawyer workflows to how we evaluate and build our products.

• Work on complex customer problems: partner with Customer Success and Sales on cases needing deeper legal expertise — understand the underlying problem, shape practical solutions, and feed what you learn back into Product.

• Help lawyers work effectively with AI: build workflows and examples that help customers get real value from AI in their legal work, and flag recurring needs that could inform future product decisions.

**What You’ll Bring

**We’re primarily looking for strong legal expertise and judgement. You don’t need a background in engineering, AI, or product development — those are things you can develop in the role.

• Advanced legal education or professional legal qualification, with a strong foundation in UK law gained through your education and/or professional training. You should be able to independently research, analyse, and assess UK complex and abstract legal questions.

• A couple of years of hands-on legal experience from a law firm, in-house legal team, public institution, or comparable legal environment.

• Strong experience with legal research and analysis, and the ability to work independently with complex legal questions and source material.

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess the quality of legal work, identify weaknesses or unsupported conclusions, and explain clearly what could be improved.

**Nice to have

**You don’t need to tick every box below. These are a plus, not requirements:

• Hands-on experience using AI tools for legal work, such as legal research, drafting, contract analysis, or document review.

• Familiarity with prompting, LLM evaluations, or systematically testing AI-generated outputs.

• Experience with document-heavy or structured legal workflows, such as due diligence, contract review, regulatory analysis, or multi-jurisdictional research.

• Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders and translating complex legal needs into practical solutions.

• Exposure to product development, user testing, or workflow design.

• Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or legal systems, particularly both common-law and civil-law systems.

• Basic technical or data literacy, such as structured data, APIs, advanced spreadsheets, or simple scripting.

• Additional language skills beyond English.

**How We Work

Do you want to lead one of the most exciting growth areas in the Nordic energy market?

As Head of Flexibility Solutions, you lead the strategic development, commercial growth, and operational excellence of Mind Energy’s flexibility business.

You’re leading a multidisciplinary domain being responsible for flexibility products, ancillary services, market participation, and the digital platform that enables it all. Working at the intersection of business, technology, operations, and energy markets, you will create scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer value while strengthening Mind Energy's position as a leading flexibility partner in the Nordics.

DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE

At Mind Energy, we organize around domains rather than traditional functional silos.

Each domain brings together commercial, operational, product, and technical capabilities around a shared business objective and customer outcome. This enables faster decision-making, stronger ownership, and closer collaboration across the value chain.

In this role you lead the Flexibility Domain and bring together commercial specialists, traders, product experts, developers, and operations professionals around a common mission: delivering market-leading flexibility solutions that create customer value and accelerate the energy transition.

Your mission is to:

• Define and lead the Flexibility Domain strategy, priorities, and roadmap, ensuring long-term business performance, growth, value creation, and market readiness.

• Drive the commercial development of flexibility solutions by translating customer needs, market developments, commercial opportunities, and regulatory changes into scalable products, services, business capabilities, and system initiatives.

• Co-own the roadmap and evolution of the Energy Trading Management Platform with the Product Owner, guiding investment and prioritization decisions across products, processes, and technology to deliver measurable business value.

• Ensure operational excellence across activation, monitoring, settlement, and performance management, while acting as the escalation point for critical commercial, operational, market, and system challenges and maintaining deep insight into Nordic balancing markets, ancillary services, and TSO requirements.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team built on ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, turning market complexity into clear priorities, scalable solutions, and tangible results.

JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS

Working alongside commercial specialists, traders, developers, product experts, and operations professionals, you join a high-performing, cross-functional domain with end-to-end ownership of our flexibility business.

Combining deep market expertise with commercial, operational, and technical capabilities, the team has the mandate to make decisions that directly impact our products, customers, and business results. This setup enables close collaboration, rapid execution, and the ability to turn market complexity into scalable solutions that drive growth and support the energy transition.

LET’S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU

You are a commercially minded leader who thrives in complex environments and enjoys turning market opportunities into scalable solutions.

You combine strategic thinking with operational execution and know how to create results through people, collaboration, and clear priorities.

We imagine you bring:

• Proven leadership experience with responsibility for people, business performance, and strategic execution, including building and developing high-performing teams

• Strong commercial acumen and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align commercial, operational, and technical interests to drive growth and value creation

• Experience balancing strategic priorities with operational execution and day-to-day delivery

• Relevant experience from the energy sector, preferably within flexibility, balancing markets, ancillary services, trading, or grid-related services

• Excellent communication skills, fluency in English, and a relevant degree or equivalent experience

• Knowledge of demand response, virtual power plants (VPPs), and balancing products such as mFRR, aFRR, and FCR is an advantage

• Proficiency in a Nordic language is an advantage

WE MIGHT BE BIASED, BUT IT IS QUITE AWESOME HERE

People here care about doing things well and creating a place people genuinely enjoy being part of. We like to hack the everyday, from breakfast and lunch made in-house with organic ingredients to in-house massage, something in the freezer when the day runs late and the occasional “Just Because” surprise. You also get five Switch Days, equal to a seventh holiday week, giving you extra flexibility and room to recharge throughout the year.

Through Mind Club, people come together around everything from padel and Football Shirt Fridays to clay pigeon shooting, movie premieres and our Christmas family day. And with Mind Academy, you grow alongside sharp and curious colleagues who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other level up. These are just some of the things that make us special. It’s easier to experience in person.

We’re mindful achievers. It shapes how we work, think and grow together, while recognizing that well-being, care and integrity matter just as much as the results we create. This is a place to focus, grow and achieve more.

LET US GET THIS CONVERSATION STARTED

If you want to join us – do not wait – send your resume and application as soon as you can, and no later than October 27, 2026.

Please send a short resume and application including:

• your motivation

• key examples of competences and experience

• your personal profile

If you have questions regarding the position, feel free to contact Vice President, Commercial Excellence, Sidse Mogensen by email at simo@mindenergy.com.

For general recruitment matters, contact people@mindenergy.com.

Can you bring together people, technology, and commercial ambition to accelerate the energy transition? Help us write the next chapter.

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Sensing Solutions, we develop advanced sensing technologies supporting applications across the Danfoss portfolio. Our work includes solutions for areas such as data centers, gas sensing, energy-efficient cooling, and environmental monitoring.

As our Development Engineer, you’ll help bring new sensing technologies and product concepts from idea to reality. Working alongside experienced engineers and technology specialists, you’ll contribute to developing products supporting our Data Center, Gas Sensing, and future technology programs.

Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.

• Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.

• Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.

• Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.

• Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.

• Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

**You’re a great match if

**

• You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team

• You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off

• You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them

• You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team

• You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

**Nice to have

**

• Experience working on live games

**Requirements For Any Job At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture

• You value a positive work environment

• You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

**Practicalities

**

• Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen

• Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role

• 37-hour work week, with flexible work hours

• No crunch, we put people before deadlines

• Our working language is English

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects

• The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of paid vacation

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• Pension plan and private health insurance

• Endless amounts of coffee

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. **

• Leading commercial evaluation of risks and opportunities facing your projects,

• Understanding and demonstrating impact of changes on customer business cases for energy projects,

• Preparation and presentation of project specific sales forecasts and budgets to high-level management,

• Working with the commercial team to establish and implement efficient processes and best practices.

What You **Bring

**

• A passion for renewable energy and a sense of the importance to lead the change,

• Knowledge of customer business case, preferably for energy projects,

• Demonstrable commercial contract management skills including in commercial negotiations, preferably within sales and/or the energy or construction sector,

• Good interpersonal skills with ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment and the ability to multi-task to meet deadlines,

• An ability to communicate technically complicated topics concisely to high-level management and customers in a high-pressure environment,
